  {α ι : Type} [MetricSpace α] [Fintype ι]
  (f : ι → α → ℝ) (h : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) :
  IsClosed {x : α | ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i x} := by
  have h₁ : ∀ (i : ι), IsClosed {x : α | 0 ≤ f i x} := by
    intro i

      exact isClosed_Ici
    have h₄ : IsClosed (f i ⁻¹' {y : ℝ | 0 ≤ y}) := h₃.preimage h₂
    have h₅ : {x : α | 0 ≤ f i x} = f i ⁻¹' {y : ℝ | 0 ≤ y} := by

    (try tauto) <;>

      {
        intro i
        have h₃ := h i
        exact h₃
      })
  
  have h₃ : IsClosed (⋂ (i : ι), {x : α | 0 ≤ f i x}) := by
    apply isClosed_iInter
    intro i
    exact h₁ i
  
  have h₄ : IsClosed {x : α | ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i x} := by
    rw [h₂]
    exact h₃
  
  exact h₄
